Title: Karan and the Family

Cast

1. Karan - 28 years, prince, son
Look: turban, blue angarkha, a sash
2. Kavita - 64 years, queen, mother
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
3. Ajay - 45 years, general
Look: iron armour, red turban
4. Manoj - 37 years, friend
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The battlefield - tents, flags, dust

Scene 1: The battlefield - Day

[Karan stands on the battlefield. Kavita and Ajay stand near him.]

Karan: "What lovely weather!"

[Karan draws his sword and charges.]

Karan (softly): "What next?"

[Karan blocks the blow with his shield.]

Ajay: "Careful!"

[Karan mounts his horse and rides into battle.]

Karan: "That's easy."

[Karan salutes the general.]

Karan: "I really enjoyed today."
